messages:
Tania (Hiring Manager): Heads up — candidate in EMEA accepted verbal. We need an exception path: their start has to be 2025-02-03 (earlier than posted) and they asked for localized PTO accrual + a one-time sign-on to cover notice pay. Also a small relocation stipend (remote->hybrid). Can we route?
Leo (Recruiter): cc @Sara (People Ops) and @Jamie (Finance). Candidate is L5 IC, base 160k EUR eq. Details below. Want to share offer draft for approvals.
Leo (Recruiter): Offer snapshot:
```
Base: 160000 EUR
Equity: 0.6% (4yr)
Sign-on request: 8,000 EUR one-time
Relocation stipend: 2,000 EUR one-time
PTO: local statutory accrual (candidate requests 28 days)
Start: 2025-02-03 (needs to be before manager travel window)
```
Jamie (Finance): Quick Qs — is the 8k sign-on taxable gross? Also need cost-center + commit code: REQ-48291. Will approvals include a provisional uplift to total comp or one-time only?
Tania (Hiring Manager): one-time only. We can’t move base. Need PTO aligned to local law; candidate had 28 days where they are, but job posting used US default 20 days.
Sara (People Ops): Thanks — routing rules: any cross-geo PTO exception + sign-on above 5k requires People Ops director signoff + Finance ack. For relocation stipend under 5k, we can approve at Ops lead level but since sign-on is 8k, it'll escalate. Also need payroll to confirm tax withholding approach.
Jamie (Finance): Ack. I'll confirm payroll flow and whether sign-on should be grossed-up. ETA EOD.
Tania (Hiring Manager): If it helps, hiring manager notes business criticality — there's a project window. Would prefer not to delay.
Sara (People Ops): Two options: 1) Provisional uplift approval (Maya signoff) to allow offer to go out with condition we finalize tax treatment; 2) Offer with contractor bridging until payroll finalizes. Which do you prefer?
Leo (Recruiter): Option 1 preferred — candidate likely declines delays. We can include conditional language: "Offer contingent on final payroll paperwork and taxation confirmation."
Maya (People Ops Director): I can approve the one-time sign-on 8,000 EUR and localized PTO 28 days given business justification, on condition Finance confirms payroll handling and budget owner signs REQ-48291. Approve contingent start date 2025-02-03. Please add immigration/legal loop if visa paperwork needed.
Jamie (Finance): Confirmed REQ-48291 chargeback ok. Payroll says sign-on will be treated as taxable income, no gross-up by default; if manager wants gross-up they must cover incremental cost center.
Tania (Hiring Manager): Understood — manager will not gross-up. Thanks Maya + team. I'll update offer language to the conditional phrasing and submit.
onboarding-bot: Offer document created and shared to candidate (draft) — link: https://redwood.example/offers/REQ-48291 (draft).
Leo (Recruiter): I'll push the verbal with the conditional language now. Will loop back once candidate signs. :thumbsup:
Sara (People Ops): Filing note: exception recorded as EX-2025-009 (comp & PTO alignment). Saving to People Ops exception tracker. If candidate signs, Ops will generate final approval memo for payroll.
Tania (Hiring Manager): Great, thanks everyone.
Maya (People Ops Director): Marking as approved-in-principle. Follow-ups: payroll confirmation, legal if cross-border employment, and final sign-off memo after acceptance.
